st: Night of the Day of the Dead
d: Kate believes that a prop from the horror movie "Day of the Dead" has turned her friends into zombies.
Lizzie, Gordo and Miranda enter a competition hoping to win a trip to Miami; Matt and Lanny start a band.
On the advice of her mother, Lizzie decides to go out with a geeky kid named Larry; Sam, Matt and Gordo try to refurbish an old downhill racer.
Gordo becomes obsessed with mastering a board game and flunks a test at school; both Lizzie and Miranda's fathers get caught up in a school project.
Lizzie and Kate are assigned as partners on a social studies project; Matt convinces everyone he is psychic.

Ash Ketchum, a 10-year-old from Pallet Town, is finally old enough to receive his first Pokémon; however, he oversleeps and the only remaining Pokémon at Professor Oak's lab is a strong-willed Pikachu!

Ash, carrying his badly wounded Pikachu, rushes into Viridian City, which is on alert for Pokémon thieves like Jessie, James and Meowth of Team Rocket; Ash tries in vain to fight off Team Rocket's Pokémon, but his Pikachu and others join the fray.
Ash captures his first Pokémon, a Caterpie; Ash battles for and wins a Pidgeotto; Ash's Caterpie surprises everybody in his first battle against Team Rocket.
A young samurai challenges Ash to a battle; a swarm of angry Beedrill interrupt the battle causing Ash to flee and leave Metapod behind.
While in Pewter City, Ash challenges Brock to a battle; Team Rocket falls into a trap they built themselves.
A scientist leads Ash and his friends deep into Mount Moon to find the storied Moon Stone, which is said to increase the power of Pokémon.
Ash seeks to win trainer badges in Cerulean City by confronting the gym leaders; Misty doesn't want to join the Ash on this journey.

st: The Path to the Pokémon League
d: Ash wins his second badge and learns of a fierce trainer, A.J., who has never lost a match; Ash prepares to challenge A.J.
Ash discovers a school for Pokémon trainers that bullies the kids to make the stronger; Misty challenges the ringleader, Giselle, to a battle.
The gang finds themselves in a town where Melanie takes care of injured or abandoned Pokémon; Ash earns a battle with Melanie.

Ash, Misty and Brock come across an injured Charmander on their way to Vermilion City; Ash tries to catch it, but it turns out it has a trainer and can't be captured, so they head to the Pokémon Center.
Ash, Misty and Brock become the victims of the Squirtle Squad's pranks; the Squirtle lets Pikachu get medicine from town after being injured.
The party meets Bill, a Pokémon researcher who is waiting in his lighthouse for the coming of a one-of-a-kind Pokémon, never before seen by humans; could such a Pokémon truly exist?

Eager to earn a badge, Ash challenges Lt. Surge; Pikachu reluctantly enters the battle, only to discover that its opponent is a Raichu, a fierce Pokémon with tremendous electric power and the evolved form of Pikachu!
Ash and his friends board a ship called the St. Anne, but the ship's employees reveal themselves to be members of Team Rocket.

A powerful storm forces everyone except Team Rocket and the heroes to abandon the sinking St. Anne; Ash, Brock and Misty are forced to team up with their long-standing enemies in order to survive this sticky situation!
The heroes and Team Rocket beat the odds by surviving the sinking of the St. Anne; they are dragged into another perilous situation when they are attacked by Gyarados!
Team Rocket attempts to get rid of the Tentacool at Porta Vista, but their plan backfires; the Tentacool are transformed into giant Tentacruel and attack Porta Vista.
Ash, Misty and Brock arrive in the port city of Maiden's Peak and join in the summer festival; Brock and James may be part of the legend of Maiden Park.
On a cliff over the ocean, the gang discover a flock of Butterfree searching for mates; Ash's Butterfree joins the flock but is rejected.
The gang finally arrives in Saffron City; a young girl, Sabrina, commands a Pokémon Gym with her psychic powers; Ash challenges Sabrina to a battle for the Marsh Badge.
Ash is on the search for a ghost-type Pokémon to try to defeat Sabrina; the gang heads to the Pokémon Tower in Lavender Town, where they are said to live.
Leaving Pokémon Tower with Haunter in tow, Ash returns to Saffron City with only one goal in mind; he looks to win a Gym Badge from the powerful Sabrina!
When Ash tries to catch a wild Mankey, it loses its cool and uses Thrash on the whole gang; Team Rocket makes matters worse when it arrives.
Ash is denied entry into the Gym for criticizing a perfume which is made there; Ash goes to outrageous lengths to win entry into the Gym.
Ash and the team help Officer Jenny search for missing children; Nurse Joy's patients are not getting well; a mysterious Sleep Wave has been hitting the town.
Brock would like to be Susie's trainee in her Pokémon beauty salon; a new salon opens up on Scissor Street, and is hassling the long-term shop owners.
Pikachu tries to beat Hitmonchan; Brock, Ash, Geodude and Primeape enter the P1 Grand Prix in Celadon City.

st: He Ain't a Hottie, He's My Brother
d: Miley is horrified when she discovers Lilly is thinking of dating Jackson and does everything she can to stop it from happening.
Miley learns to drive, but finds it's not as easy as she thought, and she fails the test. Using her celebrity status she gets a second one and passes, but as Hannah.
When she needs to go to the dentist, Miley decides to go without her dad, but it proves to be a mistake. Oliver tries to stop Joanie, a vegetarian, from finding out he eats meat.

st: You Never Give Me My Money
d: When Miley asks for a raise on her allowance, Robby decides to teach her about fiscal responsibility.

st: Killing Me Softly With His Height
d: Miley criticizes Oliver for being shallow, but then realizes she is too when she breaks up with a boy because he's short.

st: Would I Lie to You, Lilly
d: Lilly won't let Miley pay for her class trip to Washington and instead has a sale to raise the money.
Oliver gets jealous of Miley's success when she gets a call back to an audition, and he doesn't, so she sabotages her own chance to be a movie star to get him back.
Hannah's dislike of carrots causes her fans to stop eating them; Jackson and Oliver are approached to model for a brochure.

st: Papa's Got a Brand New Friend
d: Hannah searches for a replacement for her injured choreographer; Oliver is too scared to break up with his girlfriend.
Hannah has a hit song with Austin Rain. On screen, it looks like get along well, but they can't stand each other. Hannah owns up on TV, to persuade Jackson not to cheat in an exam.

st: Knock Knock Knockin' on Jackson's Head
d: When Jackson gets amnesia after hitting his head, Miley lies to him and tells him he usually waits on her hand and foot.

st: You Give Lunch a Bad Name
d: Miley and Jackson are horrified to learn that their grandmother has gotten a job at their school.

st: What I Don't Like About You
d: Hannah returns from making a movie and discovers Lilly and Oliver have been secretly dating.
Hannah schedules a recording session with David Archuleta to avoid going to the prom with Aaron but realizes it's mean and goes after all.
When Miley's date cancels, he sends her a replacement; Rico is extra nice to Jackson after an injury.

st: Jake... Another Little Piece of My Heart
d: Miley's in Las Vegas when she hears Traci is eloping with Miley's ex-boyfriend.

st: Miley Hurt the Feelings of the Radio Star
d: Oliver auditions as a radio co-host but gets stage fright, so Miley helps out.
Miley loses both the lucky charm anklet her mother gave her and her Hannah wig and thinks it will bring bad luck.

st: I Honestly Love You (No, Not You)
d: Miley breaks her ankle. She has an out-of-body experience where she sees Oliver professing his love for her.
During a radio interview Miley says some things that upset Jackson, then doesn't believe him when he forgives her for it.
Miley, Jackson and Robby trade in Mamaw's car for a newer one.
Hannah fills in as a guest judge on "America's Top Talent"; Robby makes Jackson clean the attic as punishment for receiving a traffic ticket.

st: Underground Monster Wrestling Club; Pirates of the Chibibbean; Gone Barry Gone
d: Cricket discovers a top-secret monster wrestling club; Molly McGee races Pirate Redd to find treasure; Perry and Kiff think Tilly kidnapped Barry.

st: A New Future; I Missed Breakfast
d: Griffin and Juno visit V's MOD to figure out how he can convince Bakugan to join his side; Dan and Drago face off against V and Nillious, hoping to bring Ventri back to the Misfits.
Yuamu has to put her fears behind her when she takes on Phazer!
Sigrid and Ciel visit Persona, hoping to ask Multi for help customizing the Bey entrusted to Sigrid by Ginro.
The friends arrive at a prairie where a family of ranchers prepares for its annual Pokémon race; when the rancher's daughter is injured, she asks Ash to enter the race in her place.
Key cannot wait to finally show off his new signature move in a heated face-off against The Bards.

st: Chibivengers; Star Butterfly Effect; Kiff Possible
d: Dr. Doof traps all the heroes and tries to take over the Chibiverse; Phineas time-travels with Merian to fix a party; Kiff and Barry must save Kim Possible from Lord Hater.

t: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug and Cat Noir
d: Marinette plans a surprise for Sabine's birthday; but she is the one caught by surprise when Uncle Wang turns up specially from Shanghai in order to spend the day with the whole family; the joy of seeing her uncle again is short-lived as Marinette soon finds his behavior suspicious; he decides to initiate the secret protocol.

t: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug and Cat Noir
d: While Marinette sees Alya get increasingly closer to uncovering her secrets, Ladybug comes up with a plan to flush the new holder of the Butterfly Miraculous out.
With summer vacation at hand, Phineas and Ferb decide to make each day more exciting than the last with outrageous adventures.
Isabella sends a letter to Phineas admitting her true feelings; Doof invents an "inator" to disguise himself as the local pizza delivery boy.
After Doofenshmirtz is defeated, a new threat in the 2nd Dimension emerges, leaving it up to Phineas, Ferb, Candace and her resistance fighters to defeat this new foe.

st: It's a Bird, It's Insane, It's Dale
d: Dale finds a meteorite that gives him superpowers.
Monty's plans to make some cheese chowder lead him to some shady characters.
A cheese shortage leads the Rangers to Rat Capone's hideout.
Nimnul's new ray gun shrinks Chip and Dale.
Gadget advocates a kinder, gentler method of solving crimes.
A witch's bat develops a crush on Dale.
A supermagnet sidetracks a sparrow on its way to Capistrano.

st: When You Fish Upon a Star
d: Monty takes the Rescue Rangers on a trip to Canine Island.
Phineas and Ferb assemble an extreme batting challenge; Candace finds herself in a predicament involving extreme water sports.
Nimnul's new weapon makes Monty grow older.
Monty's mother visits; buildings start falling over.

t: Big City Greens the Movie: Spacecation: Sing-Along
d: Thrill-seeker Cricket Green tricks his country family into taking a road trip in space, which ends up endangering all of Big City.
Cricket and Tilly sell Gramma's knitted gifts to experience Christmas again... and again; Gloria tries to best her cousin Emily and winds up skating in an embarrassing ice show.
Ron battles the stinky skunk supervillain White Stripe.
Ron becomes an exchange student at a secret ninja school in Japan; Kim and Monique like the same guy.

st: Rufus vs. Commodore Puddles; Day of the Snowmen
d: Drakken "supersizes" Puddles the poodle; evil, toxically mutated snowmen terrorize Middleton.
Christmas tranquility agreeably follows pitched battles in the Arctic.
The Bebebots set out to create an army with Bonnie as their queen.
Wade sends Kim and Ron to steal from Dr. Dementor; Kim and Bonnie enter the talent competition.
Ron and Kim return to cheerleading camp and find Gill changed.
Old teammates need Shego's help battling a bird-brained villain in Chicago.
Kim's ongoing bad luck with school photos continues when she begins to turn into a monkey.
Drakken zaps Kim with a ray that makes her vanish when she blushes.
Drakken hits on DNAmy because of her mutation skills, leaving Kim and her science partner to foil their plot.
A kidnapping spurs Kim to rescue Ron and hostage teen idols.
Kim goes undercover as an X-games competitor to pursue a tattooed thief.
Mother's Day brings turmoil for Kim's and Drew's moms.
Motor Ed steals car parts to create a super monster truck.
Royalties make Ron a self-absorbed millionaire.
Kim goes undercover as an X-games competitor to pursue a tattooed thief.
Kim learns of an ancestor's misdeeds and aims to clear the family name.
No one invites Dad to the Crooked D Ranch Research Roundup.
Motor Ed and Drakken team up to steal advanced cyber-robotic technology.
Microchips make Kim and Shego emotionally unstable.

st: His Strength Is Now Our Strength; Broke This World
d: Dan and the Misfits devise a plan to break Drago and Ventri out of V's underground hideout; TC learns the truth about his past and how he wound up with no memory.
The Skyfish discover Phazer's secret, but Tremolo will do anything to keep those fish from flapping their lips!
Sigrid and Ciel visit Persona, hoping to ask Multi for help customizing the Bey entrusted to Sigrid by Ginro.

st: Candace's Old Year Resolutions; Snowball BattleRoyale; Love Boat Liars
d: Candace tries to finish all her New Year's resolutions in one day; chibis battle for hot cocoa in a snowball war; Helen and Scratch pretend to be a couple to board a cruise ship.
When Ash finds himself in a safari zone where Pokémon are protected, he learns the secret of a special Pokémon trainer.
Key hopes to get a glimpse of a Gorotama game.
Kiff and Barry accidentally cause a town-wide blackout by upsetting a Lighthouse Keeper. Kiff has dinner at the Buns' and has to hide that she hates the food.
Kiff runs for class president against a surprise candidate, Mr. RiPeppa. The Chatterleys take Barry on their island vacation, but he seems to have a dark secret.
Kiff and Barry try to stay awake until 4am to see a very special comet. Kiff meets a bad banana.
Saxon finds love; Remy's parents bond with him.
Gramma assembles a seaworthy crew to retrieve packages stolen by Big City's porch pirates; Nick creates a fake scouting troop to trick Cricket and Tilly into raising money for him.
The Greens get the work out of their life at Big City's new gym; Cricket finds a loophole to his curfew that will let him attend a late-night drone show.
Gus has never had a school picture taken, and is very excited, but he's not having it done until the end of the day.
Wild stories abound when T.J. shows up with a black eye; Randall becomes a standup comedian.

st: That Stinking Feeling; Lord of the Nerds
d: Spinelli discovers to her horror that she's got a crush on a boy; TJ breaks his collarbone and makes a whole new set of friends with the strange Pale Kids, who actually choose to stay inside during recess.

st: My Funny Valentines; The Ratings Game
d: T.J. does not want to send Valentine cards; the Ashleys want to split up the schoolyard.
Feeling left out and unappreciated, Menlo and Randall join forces to rule the playground; Vince always wins, so the gang bets him he can't go a whole day without winning.

st: Spinelli's Masterpiece; Nobody Doesn't Like T.J
d: Spinelli creates a beautiful chalk masterpiece on the asphalt in the playground; when TJ discovers a kid who doesn't like him, he becomes determined to find out why and turn the kid around.

st: Yope From Norway; The Library Kid
d: Gus pretends to be the hottest guy in school in order to befriend a new kid from Norway.

st: Me No Know; Good Ole T.J
d: Vince is desperate to see the latest hit movie, but his parents won't let him go; when he goes against their wishes, he gets into big trouble; Gretchen partners with TJ for a project and gets her worst grade ever.
Phineas and Ferb discover an old coin and are transported back in time.
TJ plays a prank on Randy and is himself challenged by King Bob; Gus gets a taste for hustling and ends up working for the Hustler Kid, which upsets his friends.

st: Gus and Misdemeanors; A Science Fair to Remember
d: Gus learns a valuable lesson about owning up when he steals candy from Kelso's; Gretchen takes on a protégé for the science fair, not realizing her new friend intends to steal her project and win the prize.
The legendary coolest kid at Third Street returns 15 years later as a resource teacher, but being cool now might get him fired.

In a parallel universe far away, Phineas and Ferb are tasked with returning the Death Star plans to the Rebel Alliance before Storm Trooper Candace catches up to them; complications arise when Perry is trapped in carbonite.
When Miss Tutweiler assigns the class to write and direct their own play, Cody and Bailey each write their versions of their breakup.
Woody's sister Willa comes to visit the S.S. Tipton, and while Woody is stuck doing homework, Cody offers to show her around.
London offers to take Bailey home for her grandma's 90th birthday party, but when her blimp goes down, the girls must road-trip to Kettlecorn.
When Cody arrives in Kettlecorn, he learns that he is not Bailey's only ex-boyfriend who has come to win her back.
After three seasons, London Tipton's tycoon father and owner of the Tipton hotel and S.S. Tipton, makes an unobscured appearance when Cody begs him to help save Bailey's family farm in Kettlecorn.
Woody accidentally releases a crate of snakes on the boat, and it's up to him and London to track them all down.

It's Senior Ditch Day, and Zack, London and Woody try to get in a very exclusive club. Cody and Bailey go to class. Miss Tutweiller wants to finish her romance novel, so she gives them an assignment to 'have fun'.
As punishment for a prank, Moseby cancels the prom. Not prepared to let something like that spoil their fun, Zack plans to hold a secret prom. Bailey is desperate to be prom queen.
Maya accepts a Peace Corps assignment and breaks up with Zack; Cody and Bailey worry about their future together; the gang realizes they will always be friends.
All aboard for mischief and mayhem as the twins Zack and Cody board the SS Tipton to attend the Seven Seas High School.
Zack goes broke buying gifts for the girls aboard the ship; Cody enters a yo-yo competition to impress Bailey.
Violet's snobbish mother and rich would-be boyfriend Aaron try to keep Zack away from her by pretending he has stolen her valuable necklace, called The Kidney of the Sea.
Zack and Cody sneak out after curfew to see the ship's cabaret show Starlight Follies. They are convinced one of the dancers is their teacher Miss Tutweiler.
When the ship crosses the International Dateline just as Cody makes his move on Bailey, time is reversed and the day is repeated.
When the SS Tipton stops in Greece the twins meet Arwin's cousin Milos. Cody gives Bailey a replica of the amulet that's being exhibited, but discovers it's the real thing.
London escapes the Seven Seas High and the ship must stop at Parrot Island to search for her. But her friends may not make it back to the boat in time after they are arrested.

Cody and Bailey are working on a science project trying to prove a Pacific Ocean sea monster called Galápagos Gerty exists. London, Zack, and Woody accidentally create a sea monster that takes them hostage.

The gang is visited by old friends when Barbara, Bob and Chelsea board the ship. Zack wants to spend some real guy time with Bob, Cody worries about how he should break up with Barbara, as he is in love with Bailey.
Zack and Cody help security guard Kirby pass his exams, London embarrasses Bailey on her internet show "Yay Me" in a new segment called "Boo You".

During a matchmaking quiz Zack and London conspire to get Miss Tutwiler and Mosby together thinking it will make their lives easier. Cody sneaks a look at Bailey's paper so he's matched with her, but it doesn't work out.
Bill buys the kids a metal detector; when Gramma complains that Cricket and Tilly are soft, the kids try to prove they can handle the deprivations of Gramma's childhood.
When Bill betrays Cricket's trust, Cricket traps him in a cage and runs to an amusement park; Tilly trains Cricket to be civilized so he can go to a fancy gala at the Remingtons.
After a fight with his mom, Remy decides to skipper his own ship in the annual regatta; Tilly fears her family is growing distant and starts a newspaper to keep them connected.

To impress his new neighbors, Cricket attempts to launch a chicken into space; the Greens are excited to continue their traditional monthly steak dinner, but Cricket accidentally loses the steaks on the subway.

Cricket must wrestle a wild animal in order to prove himself worthy of the family name; when Cricket persuades Bill to convert his pickup into a french fry food truck, he discovers a mysterious blue potato that Gramma says is cursed with bad luck.
When the Greens visit an indoor pool, Cricket is challenged to jump off the high dive; Tilly claims that the family's goat has the spirit of a dog and enters it in a dog show.
When Gramma crashes into a parked police car, she loses her driver's license and her confidence; Cricket Green hates bears.

Bill takes the family on a road trip to the country, only to wind up trapped in a traffic jam; when Tilly finds a bird's nest, she cares for the eggs hoping the chicks will think she's their mother, but the birds imprint on Cricket instead.
Bill takes Gramma to a doctor's checkup and leaves Tilly in charge of Cricket; Cricket learns that Bill never realized his childhood dream of becoming a gymnast.
Cricket Green and his family move from the country to Big City to live with Gramma; when Cricket and Bill accidentally disturb a nest of raccoons in the garage, they invade the house.

Bill promises his family a trip to the mall food court; when he reveals it was just a trick to get them to a family portrait studio, Cricket and Gramma try to escape; Remy is caught skipping his violin lessons to hang out with Cricket.

While dining at a seafood restaurant, Bill feels he must prove to the waiter that he is a Big City local, and Cricket and Tilly try to rescue a live octopus; when Cricket loses all of his critterballs over the fence, Gloria refuses to return them.
Cricket leaves Gloria to work the coffee shop alone while he enjoys the parade on his break; Bill uses a trip to the hardware store to teach Remy a lesson in self-reliance.
To impress her new friend, Tilly claims she saw stone gargoyles come to life; Cricket makes a deal to sell Bill's produce to a major grocery chain.
Cricket uses his first tip from working at Big Coffee to buy a singing toy fish; Gramma kicks the family out of the house for the day, so they stay in a hotel for the first time.
Gramma tells Cricket and Tilly that there's treasure buried on their property; Cricket adds his own doodles to Gloria's abstract paintings.
After the mysterious attack on Falco, the evidence is stacking up against one of the Knights.

st: Bunch of Misfits; Brawl or Nothing
d: Drago and Dan seem to be up to something; Mia's friends are surprised to find out that she's been hiding her brawling identity from her parents.
When Yuhi loses his Duel Disk, he has to duel old school against Asaka.

Ash Ketchum, a 10-year-old from Pallet Town, is finally old enough to receive his first Pokémon; however, he oversleeps and the only remaining Pokémon at Professor Oak's lab is a strong-willed Pikachu!
The battle between Gordias and Yggdrasil reaches the third set as each team's leader takes to the stage.
On Halloween Night, Spider-Man must team up with the Incredible Hulk to stop Man-Wolf, a super-strong gamma-powered werewolf, from infecting the rest of Manhattan.
Spidey must stop a low-level villain who acquired some impressive freezing technology.
The symbiote escapes the Avengers Compound and attaches itself to a new host; Spidey must find out how to beat it and discover the identity of the new person underneath.
New costumed figure Screwball pranks Spidey, so when Hammerhead and Absorbing Man capture Screwball, Spidey must decide whether to help her.

st: The Rise of Doc Ock: Part One
d: When Otto Octavius is caught in an explosion that fuses his robot arms to his body, Spider-Man sees the opportunity to recruit The Octopus into becoming a hero.

The film follows the misadventures of Jack Skellington, Halloweentown's beloved pumpkin king, who has become bored with the same annual routine of frightening people in the "real world." When Jack accidentally stumbles on Christmastown, all bright colors and warm spirits, he gets a new lease on life -- he plots to bring Christmas under his control by kidnapping Santa Claus and taking over the role
Christmas elves Lanny and Wayne panic when their holiday missions go awry, leaving Wayne thinking he's in big trouble with Santa and accidentally revealing other merry mishaps.

st: Duck the Halls: A Mickey Mouse Christmas Special
d: It's touch-and-go for Donald when, instead of heading south for the winter with Daisy and all the other ducks for the winter, he insists on staying with Mickey and the gang to enjoy all that Christmas has to offer.

Scrooge avoids the pressures of the holidays by traveling back in time with a trio of fun-loving ghosts to crash history's greatest Christmas parties; time-lost Dewey teams up with young Donald Duck to find his mother on Christmas.
As Scrooge teams up with Santa Claus, to save Christmas, Webby discovers the true reason behind their infamous feud.
Candace asks Phineas and Ferb for their help in creating the ultimate gift for Jeremy.
Louis (Shia LaBeouf) reports on the scary cafeteria lady for the school's TV newsmagazine. With Donna Pescow.
Louis (Shia LaBeouf) learns about fair play after he uses chicanery and a 12-bit drill to win a race. With Donna Pescow and Christy Romano.
On Scrub Day, Louis (Shia LaBeouf) conquers his fear of being bullied by clowning around. With Donna Pescow and Christy Romano.
Louis (Shia LaBeouf) finds a deceptively easy way to make money for a school charity by "napping for the needy.".
Louis (Shia LaBeouf) discovers Ren's (Christy Romano) secret need to escape from the demands of being perfect.
Louis and Twitty enter a contest to see who can sell the most chocolate.
